穿着.zh: 她穿着一条很难看的裙子。
穿着.pinyin: tā chuān zhuó yī tiáo hěn nán kàn de qún zi
穿着.en: She was wearing an ugly dress.

穿着.pinyin: tā men dōu chuān zhuó zhì fú
Tāng mǔ chuān zhuó yī fu shuì zháo le
穿着.en: Tom fell asleep with his clothes on.
穿着.es: Tom se quedó dormido con la ropa puesta.

穿着.zh: 弘美正穿着一条新的连衣裙。
穿着.pinyin: hóng Měi zhèng chuān zhuó yī tiáo xīn de lián yī qún
穿着.en: Hiromi is wearing a new dress.

黑暗.zh: 难怪我们会把蝙蝠和黑暗的地方联想在一起了。
黑暗.pinyin: nán guài wǒ men huì bǎ biān fú hé hēi àn de dì fang Lián xiǎng zài yī qǐ le
黑暗.en: No wonder we associate bats with dark places.
黑暗.es: No es de extrañar que asociemos los murciélagos con los lugares oscuros.

黑暗.zh: Tatoeba:加入黑暗的一面。我们有巧克力饼乾。
黑暗.pinyin: T jiā rù hēi àn de yī miàn wǒ men yǒu qiǎo kè lì bǐng gān
黑暗.en: Tatoeba: Join the dark side. We have chocolate cookies.
黑暗.es: Tatoeba: únete al lado oscuro. Tenemos galletas de chocolate.

黑暗.zh: 我们的眼睛需要时间来适应黑暗。
黑暗.pinyin: wǒ men de yǎn jing xū yào shí jiān lái shì yìng hēi àn
黑暗.en: Our eyes take time to adjust to the darkness.
黑暗.es: Nuestros ojos requieren tiempo para adaptarse a la oscuridad.

黑暗.zh: 猫在黑暗中都是灰色的。
黑暗.pinyin: māo zài hēi àn Zhōng dū shì huī sè de
黑暗.en: All cats are grey in the dark.
黑暗.es: De noche todos los gatos son pardos.

垃圾.pinyin: hé duì àn yǒu hěn duō de lā jī
垃圾.en: There's a lot of trash on the far bank of the river.
垃圾.es: Hay un montón de basura en la otra orilla del río.

垃圾.zh: 父亲生前留下来的老古董，原来只是一堆不值钱的垃圾。
垃圾.pinyin: fù qīn shēng qián liú xià lái de lǎo gǔ dǒng yuán lái zhǐ shì yī duī bù zhí qián de lā jī
垃圾.en: The antiques my father left when he died turned out to be nothing but worthless junk.
垃圾.es: Las antigüedades que dejó mi padre al morir resultaron no ser más que basura inútil.

垃圾.zh: 在新加坡的街道上扔垃圾会被罚款。
垃圾.pinyin: zài Xīn jiā pō de jiē dào shàng rēng lā jī huì bèi fá kuǎn
垃圾.en: They fine you in Singapore if you throw trash in the streets.
垃圾.es: En Singapur te dan una multa si tiras basura en la calle.

垃圾.pinyin: bié zài zhè r rēng lā jī

愿.pinyin: yuàn dà néng yǔ nǐ tóng zài
愿.en: May the force be with you.

愿.pinyin: yuàn lì liang yǔ nǐ tóng zài
愿.en: May the force be with you.

愿.zh: 感谢你们。上帝保佑你们。愿上帝保佑美利坚合众国
愿.pinyin: gǎn xiè nǐ men Shàng dì bǎo yòu nǐ men yuàn Shàng dì bǎo yòu Měi lì jiān Hé zhòng guó
愿.en: Thank you. God bless you. And may God bless the United States of America.
愿.es: Gracias. Dios les bendiga. Y que Dios bendiga a los Estados Unidos de América.

替.zh: 他替我叫了一部计程车。
替.pinyin: tā tì wǒ jiào le yī bù jì chéng chē

替.zh: 他为了替死去的父亲报仇而杀了他。
替.pinyin: tā wèi le tì sǐ qù de fù qīn bào chóu ér shā le tā
替.en: He killed him to avenge his dead father.
替.es: Él lo mató para vengar a su padre.

替.zh: 知道你在那里过得不错，我替你感到高兴。
替.pinyin: zhī dào nǐ zài nà li guò dé bù cuò wǒ tì nǐ gǎn dào gāo xìng
替.en: Knowing that you're doing fine over there, I'm really pleased for you.
替.es: Sabiendo que te está yendo bien allá, me alegro por ti.

替.zh: 你到厨房里替我把一把锤子拿来。
替.pinyin: nǐ dào chú fáng lǐ tì wǒ bǎ yī bǎ chuí zi ná lái
替.en: Could you get a hammer for me from the kitchen please?
替.es: ¿Me podés traer un martillo de la cocina, por favor?

天下.zh: 天气预报说明天下午会下雨。
天下.pinyin: tiān qì yù bào shuō míng tiān xià wǔ huì xià yǔ
天下.en: The weather report says it will rain tomorrow afternoon.
天下.es: El informe meteorológico dice que lloverá mañana por la tarde.

天下.zh: 我们伟大的祖国无敌於天下。
天下.pinyin: wǒ men wěi dà de zǔ guó wú dí yú tiān xià
天下.en: Our great country is unmatched in the world.

天下.zh: 信心、毅力、勇气三者具备，则天下没有做不成的事。
天下.pinyin: xìn xīn yì lì yǒng qì sān zhě jù bèi zé tiān xià méi yǒu zuò bù chéng de shì
天下.en: If confidence, determination and courage are together in one place, there is nothing that cannot be done.

天下.pinyin: tiān xià wú bù sǎn zhī yán xí
天下.en: All good things must come to an end.

不对.pinyin: yǒu shén me bù duì ma

不对.zh: 你的答案不对。再试试看。
不对.pinyin: nǐ de dá àn bù duì zài shì shì kàn
不对.en: Your answer isn't correct. Try again.
不对.es: Tu respuesta no es correcta. Inténtalo otra vez.

不对.zh: 把你的失败归咎于你的父母是不对的。
不对.pinyin: bǎ nǐ de shī bài guī jiù yú nǐ de fù mǔ shì bù duì de
不对.en: It's not fair to attribute your failure to your parents.

不对.zh: 我老婆常常说我这样做不对、那样做不对。
不对.pinyin: wǒ lǎo pó cháng cháng shuō wǒ zhè yàng zuò bù duì nà yàng zuò bù duì
不对.en: My wife is always finding fault with me.

阿.zh: “我的车不需要排队阿，”他提议。
阿.pinyin: wǒ de chē bù xū yào pái duì ā tā tí yì
阿.en: "You don't have to queue for my car," he offers.
阿.es: "No tienes que esperar por mi coche", le comentó.

阿.pinyin: ā lì Sī tè shā le Bā bā lā

阿.zh: 约翰甘迺迪被安葬在阿灵顿公墓。

阿.en: J.F. Kennedy was buried in Arlington Cemetery.
阿.es: J. F. Kennedy fue enterrado en el cementerio Arlington.

阿.zh: 我可不能把阿渚交给这种文弱的男人。
阿.pinyin: wǒ kě bu néng bǎ ā zhǔ jiāo gěi zhè zhǒng wén ruò de nán rén
阿.en: I can't hand Nagisa over to such a weak man.

鹿.pinyin: wǒ gēn zhe lù de zōng jì
鹿.es: Seguimos las pistas dejadas por el venado.

鹿.pinyin: tā shè le lù yī jiàn
鹿.en: He shot an arrow at the deer.
鹿.es: Le lanzó una flecha al ciervo.

鹿.pinyin: shè shǒu dǎ sǐ le lù

湿.pinyin: wǒ bù jiè yì bèi nòng shī
湿.en: I don't mind if I get wet.

湿.pinyin: māo tǎo yàn bèi nòng shī

湿.zh: 这根湿掉的火柴点不出火的。
湿.pinyin: zhè gēn shī diào de huǒ chái diǎn bù chū huǒ de

湿.zh: 这条路因为下雨所以是湿的。
湿.pinyin: zhè tiáo lù yīn wèi xià yǔ suǒ yǐ shì shī de
湿.en: The road was wet from the rain.

不忙.pinyin: wǒ wèn tā máng bù máng
不忙.en: I'll ask him if he's busy or not.

不忙.es: La semana pasada no estuve ocupado.

寻求.zh: 他寻求他的朋友的帮助。
寻求.pinyin: tā xún qiú tā de péng you de bāng zhù
寻求.en: He asked his friends for help.
寻求.es: Él le pidió ayuda a sus amigos.

寻求.zh: 我更喜欢寻求问题的解决方法，而不仅仅是揭露它们。
寻求.pinyin: wǒ gèng xǐ huan xún qiú wèn tí de jiě jué fāng fǎ ér bù jǐn jǐn shì jiē lù tā men
寻求.en: I prefer to look for a solution to problems, not only to report them.
寻求.es: Prefiero buscarle solución a los problemas, no sólo denunciarlos.

寻求.zh: 因为不知道做什么，所以我向老师寻求建议。
寻求.pinyin: yīn wèi bù zhī dào zuò shén me suǒ yǐ wǒ xiàng lǎo shī xún qiú jiàn yì
寻求.en: Not knowing what to do, I asked the teacher for advice.
寻求.es: Sin saber qué hacer, le pedí consejo al profesor.

寻求.zh: 格列佛为寻求探险而旅行。
寻求.pinyin: gé liè Fó wèi xún qiú tàn xiǎn ér lǚ xíng
寻求.en: Gulliver traveled in quest of adventure.
寻求.es: Gulliver viajó en busca de aventuras.

尽力而为.pinyin: wǒ huì jìn lì ér wéi

尽力而为.zh: 父亲总是说"你尽力而为。"
尽力而为.pinyin: fù qīn zǒng shì shuō nǐ jìn lì ér wéi
尽力而为.es: Papá siempre dice "hazlo lo mejor que puedas."

尽力而为.pinyin: nǐ yīng gāi yǒng yuǎn jìn lì ér wéi
尽力而为.en: You should always do your best.
尽力而为.es: Es preciso siempre hacer todo lo posible.

唱片.zh: 我姑姑给了我一张唱片专辑。
唱片.pinyin: wǒ gū gu gěi le wǒ yī zhāng chàng piàn zhuān jí
唱片.en: My aunt gave me an album.
唱片.es: Mi tía me dio un álbum.

唱片.pinyin: wǒ yǒu xǔ duō chàng piàn

唱片.zh: 我不喜欢这些唱片中的任何一张。
唱片.pinyin: wǒ bù xǐ huan zhè xiē chàng piàn zhòng dì rèn hé yī zhāng
唱片.en: I don't like any of these records.
唱片.es: No me gusta ninguno de estos discos.

唱片.zh: 这些唱片我一张也不喜欢。
唱片.pinyin: zhè xiē chàng piàn wǒ yī zhāng yě bù xǐ huan
唱片.en: I don't like any of these records.
唱片.es: No me gusta ninguno de estos discos.

板.zh: 他试了试在地板上睡觉。
板.pinyin: tā shì le shì zài dì bǎn shàng shuì jiào
板.en: He tried to sleep on the floor.
板.es: Él intentó dormir en el suelo.

板.pinyin: tā de shū diào zài dì bǎn shàng le
板.en: He dropped his books on the floor.

板.zh: 本来以为是开发板给我弄坏了，原来是插头接触不良。
板.pinyin: běn lái yǐ wéi shì kāi fā bǎn gěi wǒ nòng huài le yuán lái shì chā tóu jiē chù bù liáng
板.en: At first I thought the development board was up the spout, but it was just a loose connection.

板.zh: 那些钱藏了在地板下面。
板.pinyin: nà xiē qián Zàng le zài dì bǎn xià miàn
板.en: The money was hidden beneath the floorboards.

沿.zh: 玛丽娅拿了一个鸡蛋，并将它在碗沿上敲开。
沿.pinyin: Mǎ lì yà ná le yī ge jī dàn bìng jiāng tā zài wǎn yán shàng qiāo kāi
沿.en: Mary took an egg and cracked it open on the rim of the bowl.
沿.es: María cogió un huevo y lo rompió contra en borde del cuenco.

沿.zh: 泪水沿著爱丽丝的脸颊流下来。
沿.pinyin: lèi shuǐ yán zhe Ài lì sī de liǎn jiá liú xià lai
沿.es: Lágrimas caían por la mejillas de Alicia.

沿.pinyin: Yuē hàn yán zhe hé sàn bù
沿.en: John took a walk along the river.
沿.es: John dio un paseo junto al río.

沿.pinyin: wǒ men yán zhe hé sàn bù
沿.en: We took a walk along the river.

沿着.pinyin: wǒ men yán zhe hú àn sàn bù
沿着.en: We walked along the shore of the lake.
沿着.es: Paseamos por la orilla del lago.

沿着.zh: 沿着这条大道走，你就会找到电影院了。
沿着.pinyin: yán zhe zhè tiáo dà dào zǒu nǐ jiù huì zhǎo dào diàn yǐng yuàn le
沿着.en: Go along this street, and you'll find the movie theater.
沿着.es: Ve por esta calle y encontrarás el cine.

沿着.zh: 沿着这条路直走，到第三个红绿灯的地方右转。
沿着.pinyin: yán zhe zhè tiáo lù zhí zǒu dào dì sān gè hóng lǜ dēng de dì fang yòu zhuǎn
沿着.en: Go straight down this street and turn right at the third light.
沿着.es: Baje esta calle derecho y gire a la derecha en el tercer semáforo.

沿着.zh: 请沿着这条路一直往前走。
沿着.pinyin: qǐng yán zhe zhè tiáo lù yī zhí wǎng qián zǒu
沿着.en: Go straight ahead along this street.

猫咪.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng yào liǎng zhǐ māo mī

猫咪.zh: 怎么会有猫咪这么可爱的生物？
猫咪.pinyin: zěn me huì yǒu māo mī zhè me kě ài de shēng wù
猫咪.en: How can there exist a creature as adorable as a cat?

猫咪.zh: 猫咪被洗后很生气，看到我就跑。
猫咪.pinyin: māo mī bèi xǐ hòu hěn shēng qì kàn dào wǒ jiù páo
猫咪.en: The cat was very angry after having been washed. As soon as it saw me it ran.

猫咪.zh: 在炎热的天气里，猫咪没精神地摊在地上。
猫咪.pinyin: zài yán rè de tiān qì lǐ māo mī méi jīng shén dì tān zài dì shàng
猫咪.en: In the scorching heat, the cat is spread out lethargically on the ground.

在我看来.pinyin: zài wǒ kàn lái nǐ cuò le
在我看来.en: In my opinion, you are wrong.
在我看来.es: En mi opinión, tú estás equivocado.

在我看来.zh: 在我看来，他是有道理的。
在我看来.pinyin: zài wǒ kàn lái tā shì yǒu dào li de
在我看来.en: In my opinion, he is correct.
在我看来.es: En mi opinión, él tiene razón.

在我看来.pinyin: zài wǒ kàn lái hěn yǒu yì si

在我看来.zh: 在我看来，她有一种夸张的倾向。
在我看来.pinyin: zài wǒ kàn lái tā yǒu yī zhǒng kuā zhāng de qīng xiàng
在我看来.en: It seems to me that she has a tendency to exaggerate.
在我看来.es: Me parece a mí que ella tiene una tendencia a exagerar.

挡住.pinyin: nǐ dǎng zhù le wǒ de lù

挡住.zh: 一棵倒下的树挡住了路。
挡住.pinyin: yī kē dǎo xià de shù dǎng zhù le lù
挡住.en: A fallen tree blocked the road.
挡住.es: Un árbol derribado bloqueó el camino.

挡住.zh: 一棵倒下的树挡住了通道。
挡住.pinyin: yī kē dǎo xià de shù dǎng zhù le tōng dào
挡住.en: A fallen tree blocked the path.
挡住.es: Un árbol caído bloqueaba el paso.

挡住.pinyin: zhè xiē shù dǎng zhù le fēng jǐng

树林.pinyin: wǒ zài Shù lín lǐ mí lù le
树林.en: I lost my way in the woods.
树林.es: Perdí mi camino en el bosque.

树林.pinyin: wǒ men zài Shù lín Zhōng mí lù le
树林.en: We lost our way in the woods.

树林.pinyin: wǒ xǐ huan zài Shù lín lǐ sàn bù
树林.en: I like taking a walk in the forest.
树林.es: Me gusta dar paseos por el bosque.

树林.pinyin: wǒ zì jǐ zǒu jìn le Shù lín lǐ
树林.en: I walked in the woods by myself.

第二天.pinyin: dì èr tiān wǒ de tuǐ hěn suān
第二天.en: I had sore legs the next day.
第二天.es: Al día siguiente me dolían las piernas.

第二天.zh: 我们同意了第二天一早开始。
第二天.pinyin: wǒ men tóng yì le dì èr tiān yī zǎo kāi shǐ
第二天.en: We agreed to start early the next morning.
第二天.es: Acordamos empezar temprano la mañana siguiente.

第二天.zh: 汤姆星期一来的，第二天返回了。
第二天.pinyin: Tāng mǔ Xīng qī yī lái de dì èr tiān fǎn huí le
第二天.en: Tom came on Monday and went back the day after.
第二天.es: Tom vino el lunes y volvió a su casa al día siguiente.

第二天.zh: 伊莎贝拉第二天回家了。
第二天.pinyin: yī shā Bèi lā dì èr tiān huí jiā le
第二天.en: The next day, Isabela came back home.
第二天.es: Al día siguiente, Isabela volvió a casa.

保佑.pinyin: Shàng dì bǎo yòu nǐ men

保佑.zh: 感谢你们。上帝保佑你们。愿上帝保佑美利坚合众国
保佑.pinyin: gǎn xiè nǐ men Shàng dì bǎo yòu nǐ men yuàn Shàng dì bǎo yòu Měi lì jiān Hé zhòng guó
保佑.en: Thank you. God bless you. And may God bless the United States of America.

影片.pinyin: Tāng mǔ zài kàn yǐng piàn

影片.zh: 影片得到的评价褒贬不一。
影片.pinyin: yǐng piàn dé dào de píng jià bāo biǎn bù yī

影片.zh: 萨米和莱拉一起拍了支影片。
影片.pinyin: Sà mǐ hé lái lā yī qǐ pāi le zhī yǐng piàn
影片.en: Sami and Layla did a video together.

电视节目.zh: 你最喜欢的电视节目是什么？

电视节目.es: ¿Cuál es tu programa de televisión favorito?

电视节目.zh: 你最喜欢看哪个电视节目？
电视节目.pinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan kàn nǎ ge diàn shì jié mù
电视节目.en: What is your favorite TV program?
电视节目.es: ¿Cuál es su programa de televisión favorito?

电视节目.zh: 雅尼看了他最爱的电视节目。
电视节目.pinyin: yǎ ní kàn le tā zuì ài de diàn shì jié mù
电视节目.en: Yanni watched his favorite TV show.

电视节目.zh: 我妈妈现在在看法语电视节目。
电视节目.pinyin: wǒ mā ma xiàn zài zài kàn fǎ yǔ diàn shì jié mù
电视节目.en: My mother is currently watching French Television program.

看出.pinyin: wǒ néng kàn chū nǐ shuō de huǎng lái
看出.en: I can see through your lies.

看出.zh: 你能看出有什么不同吗？
看出.pinyin: nǐ néng kàn chū yǒu shén me bù tóng ma

看出.zh: 人们可以很容易地看出其中的差别。
看出.pinyin: rén men kě yǐ hěn róng yì de kàn chū qí zhōng de chā bié
看出.en: People can easily tell the difference between them.
看出.es: La gente les puede diferenciar con facilidad.

看出.zh: 从他凌乱的房间可以看出他离开的时候很着急。
